ShikkhaOS

The Android app

A phone-first layout: bottom tabs, full-screen pages and a back button that behaves. Screens below are from the demo build with sample data.

What changedBack buttonScreens

What changed

Not a desktop on a phoneNo floating windows or dock. Four bottom tabs: Home, Menu, Alerts, Me.
Pages, not windowsOpen an app and it fills the screen with a back arrow at the top. The tabs hide while you work.
Made for thumbsLarge buttons (44 px), big app tiles, safe space for the status bar and gesture bar.
Depth and motionRaised 3D buttons that press down, cards that lift on hover, tiles that tilt, a sliding tab highlight and staggered entrance.
Live colourOne teal accent follows the school season (admission, exam, result, event). Each app tints its own tiles, buttons and highlights.
Same rules, same dataEach role sees only its own apps. Bangla, dark mode and the brand colours carry over.

Back button

Before, pressing Android’s back button inside an app closed the whole app. Now each press does one sensible step:

1 Close a pop-up→2 Leave the open page→3 Go to Home tab→4 Exit the app
Home is the only place where back leaves the app.
